description:
In Motel Renovator Simulator, take control of a neglected motel and turn it into a comfortable destination for travelers. Start with dusty, forgotten rooms and gradually restore the entire property, bringing it back to life one renovation at a time.

Clear away clutter, replace old flooring and walls, and give each room a complete makeover. Choose furniture and decorations from a variety of options to create welcoming spaces that guests will enjoy. Your renovation work is also the key to growing the business. Welcome guests, earn money from successful stays, and reinvest your profits into new furniture, materials, tools, and additional rooms. 

Upgrade your equipment to work faster and more efficiently, while experimenting with different designs to give your motel its own unique character.
From a forgotten roadside property to a thriving place for travelers, every improvement brings you closer to creating the motel of your dreams.
